verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs list a built-in Schedule trigger for workflows, and a community comment cites a 30s execution limit "for cron", so cron-style scheduled runs are supported. Nothing in the pack covers cron expression syntax or timezone control, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented cron-expression syntax, timezone selection for schedules, independent hands-on corroboration of scheduling behavior.
